name: playbook-jupi
description: Playbook-Jupi — closed-world playbook engine, forked from proactive-jupi. Runs a declared process: the user's playbook defines the frame — what is in scope, which dossiers are tracked, and the lifecycle they traverse; every hole in the playbook surfaces as a ready-to-settle Jupi decision; validated decisions become rules that graduate steps from ask-every-time to act (draft-gated). Includes a bootstrap skill that creates the playbook store, the dossiers, and runs the playbook extraction.
